status.label: Duplicate Excel Personal.xlsb lock report
status.detail: Open #29580 tracks Peek retaining the same Personal Macro Workbook resource; #40117 is related preview-handler process history.

judgment.rationale: The report describes Peek previewing Excel, leaving a residual process, and causing the next Excel launch to report Personal.xlsb as read-only. Open #29580 describes the same Personal Macro Workbook lock after Peek previews Excel and includes a reproduction; its discussion says Explorer Preview Pane produces the same behavior and attributes it to Excel. Closed #40117 separately tracked preview-handler child-process leaks and was addressed through PR #40116. This report does not establish a distinct PowerToys-only failure.
evidence: PowerToys 0.100.1 from Microsoft Store; reporter saves/closes Personal.xlsb, previews an Excel file with Peek, then opens Excel.
Reporter observes a residual process and resolves the prompt by closing it in Task Manager.
Open #29580 tracks the same Personal.xlsb lock and has maintainer reproduction plus the Excel/Explorer comparison.
Closed #40117 tracked leaked Office preview-handler processes; PR #40116 is related cleanup history.
No comments, diagnostic archive, assignee, or linked fix on #51086.
judgment.recommended_action: Link this report to #29580 and add its current-version residual-process observation there; do not start a competing design unless maintainers isolate a PowerToys-only leak.

fix_assessment.rationale: The same Personal.xlsb/Peek resource-lock symptom is tracked in #29580, where maintainers reproduced it in Explorer Preview Pane too and attributed the underlying resource behavior to Excel; this report does not justify a separate PowerToys fix.

issue_context.summary: Peek-previewing an Excel file appears to leave Excel holding Personal.xlsb, so the next Excel launch requires read-only access until the residual process is closed.
known_information: Reporter saves/closes Personal.xlsb, previews an Excel file with Peek, then opens Excel.
Reporter observes a residual process and closes it in Task Manager.
Open #29580 describes the same Personal Macro Workbook lock after Peek and reports it in Explorer Preview Pane too.
Closed #40117 reported Office preview-handler process leaks; PR #40116 is related process cleanup history.
inferences: This likely overlaps the Excel Personal Macro Workbook issue rather than proving an independent Peek lifecycle regression.
The Explorer Preview Pane comparison suggests Excel preview-handler behavior may contribute, but the target report does not identify the responsible process.
issue_context.analysis: The exact shared Personal.xlsb symptom is already under an open issue with detailed reproduction and external-ownership discussion. Consolidating the newer observation avoids duplicate work; #40117 is related process history, not proof the lock is fixed.
initial_investigation: Read the full live body; no comments, attachment links, assignees, or later updates.
Read open #29580: same Personal Macro Workbook lock after Peek, maintainer reproduction, same behavior in Explorer Preview Pane, and Excel Feedback Hub reference.
Read closed #40117: Office preview-handler process leak; related PR #40116 does not establish the Personal.xlsb lock is fixed.

Rechecked the personal.xlsb save/Peek/Excel sequence, residual-process workaround and prior Explorer-preview comparison. Retain the existing canonical symptom tracker rather than claiming the historical cleanup PR proves a current fix.

comment.body: This appears to match the Personal Macro Workbook resource lock tracked in #29580: Peek-previewing an Excel file leaves Personal.xlsb unavailable to the next Excel launch. That issue has a detailed reproduction and notes the same behavior in Explorer Preview Pane, suggesting Excel’s preview-handler path may be involved. Please consolidate this 0.100.1 residual-process observation in #29580; #40117 is related process-leak history but does not establish a fix for this lock.

upstream_safety.detail: No upstream or fork issue/PR writes were made.
